response.sql: WITH status_tallies AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT status, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM status_tallies), compared AS (SELECT status, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT status, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
